messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Inference cluster inference-east-prod reporting sustained 5xx rate > 8% over 2m. Severity: potential customer impact. Auto-triggering incident workflow.
elaine: Ack. I'm grabbing war-room and will page oncall.
elaine: war room: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/3187654321 (permissions: org-sre + eng-oncall)
pagerduty-bot: Pager sent to oncall: jay. Status: delivered.
jay: oncall here — joining war room now. taking owner.
sam: ETA to parity nodes? I see a spike in pod restarts in inference-east-1a. Investigating cluster autoscaler events.
maria: Drafting status page update. Proposed: "We are investigating increased errors affecting model inference in us-east. Some requests returning 5xx. Engineers are on it; no ETA yet. Will update within 30 minutes." Thoughts?
elaine: good start. add impacted subset: "A portion of short-poll, high-throughput endpoints" and add contact: support@redwood.ai for urgent customer help.
maria: updated draft: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors impacting a subset of inference requests in us-east. Engineers are actively investigating; some requests may return errors or time out. We will provide another update within 30 minutes. For immediate assistance contact support@redwood.ai."
jay: I have access to node logs. initial signal looks like OOMs on worker-2 leading to request queue backups. Scaling didn't kick fast enough. Assigning infra: @sam to validate autoscaler logs and @elaine to validate KV cache config rollback possibility.
sam: looking at autoscaler — there was a failed scale-up at 3187654260 due to quota. Eng infra is paged.
elaine: noted. I'll prepare fallback: route low-priority traffic to inference-west model variant to reduce load. Will need an approval from oncall — jay ok?
jay: approved. Do it after a quick traffic split test on canary (5%).
maria: drafting customer comms for targeted emails — will wait for confirmed mitigation before sending.
incident-bot: REMINDER: Please set incident priority and fill short summary: /incident set-priority P1; /incident summary "Inference 5xx spike us-east — mitigation in progress"
elaine: setting priority P1. summary updated.
sam: infra team confirmed quota bump request submitted to cloud provider — ETA 12m.
jay: ok, proceeding with canary traffic split now. will report results in 5m.
maria: status page update posted as "Investigating". link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3187654321
elaine: thanks. keep succinct updates every 10 min. if customer visible degradation continues past 20m we prepare customer email.
jay: canary shows 80% reduction in errors on split. holding while autoscaler/quotas come up.
elaine: great. I'll stay on war room for next update and coordinate comms.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: war room created, owner= jay, priority= P1, warroom_link=https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/3187654321
